comment: I2L: the Lab's deployment inputs, NAMES only (values live in the operator's stores, never here). Origins are P-08 placeholders (TO BE VERIFIED). Read by apps/infrx-api/tests/i/lab and infra/lab/app/README.md.

lab-web.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_LAB_URL
lab-web.purpose: the Lab's own https origin, no path (apps/lab/lib/auth/config.ts)

lab-web.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
lab-web.purpose: the auth/DB project the Lab session door (0030) is served from

lab-web.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
lab-web.purpose: publishable key; the Lab holds no service-role key

lab-web.name: LAB_DATASETS_API_URL
lab-web.purpose: server-only base URL of the datasets backend (WR-N4-5); unset = the datasets pages are unavailable

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_IMAGE
lab-control.purpose: the Lab control release: a content-addressed image id, rolled back by itself

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_DATABASE_URL
lab-control.purpose: the control service's own database login (L3-SQL names the role); never the runtime's DATABASE_URL

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_SUPABASE_URL
lab-control.purpose: where the control service verifies a Lab session token

lab-control.name: INFRX_LAB_ORIGIN
lab-control.purpose: the one browser origin whose Lab sessions it accepts

lab-edge.name: INFRX_LAB_CONTROL_SITE
lab-edge.purpose: the control origin's address in the App edge (default the placeholder above)

lab-edge.name: INFRX_LAB_CONTROL_UPSTREAM
lab-edge.purpose: local drill only; the box leaves it unset (127.0.0.1:8003)
